description: This file is a minified JavaScript library from the Polymer project, specifically the webcomponents-lite.js polyfill. It includes code for URL parsing, WeakMap polyfill, MutationObserver polyfill, HTMLTemplateElement polyfill, and performance/animation frame polyfills, with license and version info.

classes.name: HTMLTemplateElement
classes.description: Polyfill for HTMLTemplateElement, providing content property and decorate method.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill implementation for WeakMap if not natively available.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: Polyfill for MutationObserver, providing observe, disconnect, and takeRecords methods.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.decorate
methods.description: Decorates a template element, setting up content property and innerHTML getter/setter.

methods.name: HTMLTemplateElement.bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes all template elements in a document.
